findings: drt io.cpp reads decoder FIXED into frNet::isFixed and skips rewriting/deleting fixed wires. FlexDR switches ALL ripup to INCR when fixed nets exist.
dbNet::setWireType changes only net metadata flags; it does not rewrite encoded path opcodes. Metadata-only fixing is insufficient.
dbWireGraph explicitly does not expose patch-wire rectangles; naive graph rewrite cannot be assumed lossless.

A future retained-route ECO must prove native encoded FIXED, unchanged wire shapes/vias/widths/patches/pins/NDR for every protected net and original cell geometry, then perform actual changed-net routing, full geometry/DRC and fresh all-net RC/endpoint comparison. Fixed clock geometry does not imply unchanged coupling or clock delay.
next_experiment: Cloud-only native positive/negative controls for a geometry-preserving encoded route-class conversion before integrating this mechanism. Existing live full reroutes are not changed or restarted.
